# Saved teaching outputs

| Snapshot | Used by |
|---|---|
| `rule_three_day/` | Rule-based walkthrough and main notebook |
| `ollama_three_day/` | LLM walkthroughs, original replies, audit and main notebook |
| `long_term_dkp/` | Daily-results chapter and selected decisions |
| `multi_reservoir_month/` | Advanced network notebook |

These are selected records from completed runs. They retain the original model
replies, physical values and audit verdicts. They are examples, not default
framework settings or evidence that an operating strategy has passed.

Run `python scripts/verify_results.py` from the repository root to check the
selected file hashes and long-period water accounting without model requests.
Store new outputs under `runs/`; keep research drafts and full run journals outside Git.
